identity.title: Add run report and signals read API

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Extend the existing read-only HTTP server with GET endpoints for a run projection/report and governance signals. Keep all endpoints read-only and preserve existing /runs, /events, /replay, /audit behavior. Dependency: 8017.add-report-cli.
human_pressure.why_now: The future console should consume a stable read model rather than duplicate projection logic in JavaScript.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.
red_lines: No auth/multi-tenant platformization in this pack.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

machine_core.goal: Expose per-run projection/report/signals through additive read-only endpoints.
red_lines: No auth/multi-tenant platformization in this pack.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
invariants: Depends on: 8017.add-report-cli. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
HTTP layer delegates to application/read services.
failure_semantics: Missing projection is distinguishable from clean report.

steps.title: Add GET run report endpoint
details: 404 missing run; explicit unavailable state missing projection.

steps.title: Add GET projection endpoint only if needed
details: Avoid redundant API if report already carries complete projection.

steps.title: Test server handlers
details: Verify existing run/event routes still work where practical.

acceptance: Run report/signals are accessible through GET.
No POST/PUT mutation API is introduced.
API does not know EverRun-private fields/files.

reject_if: Projection logic is duplicated inside HTTP handler.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
